milestone: Function 1 model-selection milestone (NOT full Function 1 completion)

rejected_candidates.reason: Lower mAP50-95 (0.3757 vs 0.4205) and lower on every per-class AP50 and on precision/recall.
Lowest mAP50-95 (0.3071) despite higher input resolution (704 vs 640) and longest training time (6.2h); higher resolution did not translate into better validation performance on this dataset.

validation_protocol.test_split_status: LOCKED — not inspected or evaluated during this task
validation_protocol.note_on_imgsz: Each experiment was validated at its own training imgsz (E01/E02=640, E03=704), which is standard practice (models are evaluated at native resolution). This means mAP comparisons are fair model-to-model comparisons, but do not isolate resolution as a variable.

resource_constraint_assessment.model_size_constraint: No explicit maximum documented. All three checkpoints are 6.20 MB (identical YOLOv8n architecture) — not a discriminating factor.
resource_constraint_assessment.inference_latency_constraint: docs/architecture/component1_implementation_plan.md risk register states: 'CPU-only inference latency: if >2s, require GPU or batch mode.' This has NOT been benchmarked for any of the three experiments — Phase 5.2 (Performance benchmarking) is not yet executed.
unavailable_values: Inference-time GPU/CPU memory — not measured (only training-time peak GPU memory is recorded)
resource_constraint_assessment.conclusion: E02 meets all currently-measured resource indicators (identical model size, moderate training memory). No benchmarked resource constraint conflicts with E02 selection. Formal latency/FPS benchmarking remains a Phase 5.2 task, independent of this selection.

selection_rationale.criterion: Highest validation mAP50-95 on a consistent, leakage-verified validation set, confirmed by higher precision, recall, and every per-class AP50.
selection_rationale.evidence_summary: E02_optimized outperforms both E01_baseline and E03_high_resolution on all five evaluated metrics (mAP50, mAP50-95, precision, recall) and all seven per-class AP50 values, with no mixed or ambiguous result requiring tie-breaking.
selection_rationale.weakest_class: selvet (AP50=0.6012) — above the 0.5 minimum flag threshold used by select_best_model.py, no weak-class warning triggered.
selection_rationale.automated_confirmation: runs/component1_training/training_pipeline/select_best_model.py independently ranked E02_optimized first by validation mAP50-95 (0.4205), matching this manual verification.
selection_rationale.decision: SELECT E02_optimized as the final research detector for Component 1 Function 1.

unverified_assumptions_and_limitations: Inference latency/FPS/memory have not been benchmarked for E02 — required before any real-time or CPU-deployment claims (Phase 5.2, not yet executed).
Validation was performed on the valid split only; the locked test split has NOT been evaluated for any experiment and remains untouched per the locking policy.

Validation duration_seconds recorded in validation_valid_metrics.json (36.7s for E02) includes model load, plotting, and JSON export overhead — it is NOT a per-image inference latency measurement and must not be used as such.

Two provenance-flagged images noted in the original architecture risk register (augmented_stock-photo-blue-jeans-... and augmented_Fabric5_jpg) are present in the frozen split_manifest.csv as singleton groups in different splits (valid and train respectively) with zero cross-split group overlap — consistent with resolution via the cross-group review process (data-preprocessing/reports/cross_group_related_20261008_114158_369379/cross_group_review_FINAL_COMPLETION_20261011.txt), but this freeze task did not re-audit that review in full depth.
Complexity-stratified XAI evaluation (A1-A6 pipeline) has not yet been run against this checkpoint — that is separate, subsequent work gated on this model freeze.
This freeze records the training-run checkpoint as-is; no quantization, pruning, or export (ONNX/TorchScript) has been performed or verified.
